answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks through geographic latency triangulation. Distributed verifiers ping nodes to measure their round-trip timing delta. Attackers cannot mask clones across a shifting dune of cloud proxies, as transit times carve an unbridgeable latency canyon around co-located servers. This forces adversaries to deploy discrete physical servers and dedicated WAN links per identity. However, BGP route flaps and queue jitter can skew delays, falsely rejecting honest nodes.
